concerns.text: T015a ('Update Plan Artifact') is listed as dependent on T015 ('Apply Bonferroni Correction'). This creates a logical deadlock: T015 requires the 'full family' scope defined in the Plan (which T015a is supposed to fix), but T015a cannot run until T015 completes. The Plan update must precede the statistical correction task to resolve the scope definition.

T015 depends on T013b, which depends on T013a. T013a produces `scaling_fits.json`. However, T015 also implicitly depends on the *definition* of the 'full family of widths' which is currently contradictory between Spec (full family) and Plan (pairwise). The task order assumes the Plan is already corrected, but the correction task (T015a) is downstream. T015 must be re-ordered to depend on a resolved Plan state or the Plan update must be moved upstream.

T023 (Cross-Story Validation) depends on T015 (Bonferroni results). However, T023's logic explicitly states it 'does NOT use Bonferroni-corrected p-values' and only compares raw localization lengths. The dependency on T015 is semantically unnecessary and creates a false blocking condition. T023 should depend only on T013b (PR results) and T020b (TM results).

T017 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but its description states it 'MUST be integrated during the implementation of T012 and T013'. If T017 is a separate task to be run in parallel, it cannot 'integrate' into T012/T013 code without a sequential dependency. If it is a code-modification task, it should not be marked [P] relative to T012/T013, or T012/T013 must be re-ordered to depend on T017 completion.
